name: mordred-burnished-avenger-levelup-enter-decline-banish
notes: Mordred, Burnished Avenger (OWCdWq3mXY): "you MAY banish it". The YES/NO is answered NO: the revealed Striking Tides is not banished (so it carries no activation permission) and ends up in player 1's hand through the normal draw step.
